verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the OpenAPI document listing "credits and budgets" among the API's surfaces. That suggests a first-party budget capability, but nothing describes hard spending caps, alert thresholds, or whether a runaway workload is actually stopped. Rate limits and standby 429s are adjacent controls and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented hard spending-cap enforcement, budget alert/notification behavior, details of the budget endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
